experiments.procedure_text: Generation of xenograft tumor mice by subcutaneous injection of U-87 MG glioma cells into the flank of male athymic nude mice.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: To generate xenograft tumor mice, male athymic nude mice (Taconic, Foxn1 nu ) aged 4-10 weeks were injected subcutaneously in the flank (0.5-1 million cells in 200 μL of DMEM-F12 serum and antibiotic-free medium).
experiments.exposure_evidence: injected subcutaneously in the flank (0.5-1 million cells in 200 μL of DMEM-F12 serum and antibiotic-free medium)
experiments.regulatory_evidence: Mice were handled in accordance with institutional guideline and under protocols approved by the Animal Care and Use Committee
experiments.notes: Mice were sacrificed when tumors reached 2 cm2.

experiments.study_type: Tissue harvest and microdissection for ex vivo assay
experiments.procedure_text: Harvest of mouse liver tissue for use in intact cuboid imaging and chopping quantitation experiments.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: Livers from male nude mice without tumors (2-4 months old) were used for the intact cuboid imaging. For the chopping quantitation experiments, we used livers from adult (3 months old) C57BL6-derived mice
experiments.test_system_evidence: Livers from male nude mice... were used for the intact cuboid imaging

endpoints.label: tissue viability/morphology
endpoints.evidence: revealed that while the outer edges of the cuboid had ~1-3 layers of dead or dying cells... most of the cuboid interior appears undamaged

experiments.regulatory_evidence: Mice were handled in accordance with institutional guideline and under protocols approved by the Animal Care and Use Committee
experiments.notes: Livers harvested from non-tumor bearing mice for tissue engineering methodology development.
